## Summary

**Signalbox** — Model-railway dispatch planner, exhibition-floor proof-of-concept.

### Core Features
- **Deterministic dispatch**: Same input → same timetable every time
- **Append-only log** + **state manifest**: Fast resume (O(1), no full-log scan), safe crash recovery
- **Corruption detection**: No silent repair—detects damage and reports it exactly
- **CSV export**: Pipe logs to Excel/sheets
- **Batch dispatch**: All-or-nothing validation (validates all files before any append)
- **Python stdlib only**: Zero external dependencies

### Test Coverage
- **95 tests passing**: 52 unit + 40 corruption audit + 3 crash recovery (real SIGKILL)
- **Corruption drill verified**: Handles all deliberate fixture/log damage without crashing or losing good records
- **Crash recovery proven**: Real process kills mid-append; system detects, reports, and resumes safely

### Files & Modes

**Files:**
- `tracks.json` — track registry
- `requests.json` — train requests
- `movements.jsonl` — append-only log
- `.movements.jsonl.state` — train state (fast lookups)

**Modes:**
```bash
dispatch        # Full run
resume          # Resume from checkpoint
show            # Display log
export          # CSV export
verify          # Check for corruption
timetable       # Generate timetable
simulate        # Apply timetable with collision detection
```

✓ All tests passing  
✓ No test artifacts in repo  
✓ README updated with all features
